# The proof state

What a person can do with Hubtask is written as [use cases](../usecases/README.md), each with
numbered checks. This page counts them: how many use cases are in which state, and how many of
their checks a test proves. A check counts as proven when a file the use case names in
`checked_by` cites it by its number. No figure here can be raised without such a test.

## Use cases by state

| State | Use cases | Checks | Checks a test cites |
|---|---|---|---|
| `verified` | 145 | 996 | 996 |
| `built` | 115 | 823 | 510 |
| `partial` | 32 | 274 | 107 |
| `specified` | 1 | 4 | 0 |
| `retired` | 1 | 8 | 0 |
| All | 294 | 2105 | 1613 |

`verified` means every check is cited by a test; `built` means the use case works and some checks
are not cited yet; `partial` and `specified` name what is not met in their *Today* section.

## Bounds that only fall

Each number is a debt a gate holds: a change may lower it and may not raise it.

| Bound | Now | Held by |
|---|---|---|
| Checks of built use cases that no test cites | 313 | `make gate-docs` |
| Fixed waits in the browser walks | 355 | the web app's tests (`apps/webapp/e2e/bounds.json`) |
| Timer waits in the browser walks | 37 | the web app's tests (`apps/webapp/e2e/bounds.json`) |
| Walk suites that cite no use case check | 56 | the web app's tests (`apps/webapp/e2e/bounds.json`) |
| Answers of the walks' stand-in server outside the contract | 207 | `make gate-walks` (`test/contract/testdata/walks-baseline.txt`) |
